messages:
Ava: Deployed a soft-launch of the new pricing estimator micro-quiz to /pricing at 09:00 PT. Feature-flagged and only visible to visitors from the US and EU. Please watch funnel and leads. :rocket:
Jon: Which variant is live? micro-quiz or slider?
Ava: Micro-quiz. We shortened it to 3 targeted questions after the UX test.
Priya: Also swapped tier names for this cohort to "Launch/Core/Enterprise" following the brand refresh. Will track confusion metrics.
Marco: Sales note  we need the quiz result added to the lead webhook: recommended_tier + short_rationale. Current payload only has est_tokens_month.
Ava: Added a payload update to the deploy. @deploy-bot can you confirm webhook schema in staging?
deploy-bot: webhook-schema-update: staging -> success at 09:12 UTC. payload keys: quiz_score, est_tokens_month, recommended_tier, tier_rationale_url
Taylor: From Support: include likely support needs in payload (e.g., SLA, onboarding) so AEs can triage.
Jon: Benchmark idea  show a short cost-savings line near the estimator: "Typical customers cut token spend by ~2.5x using Redwood Optimize settings." Link to methodological appendix. Measure impact on demo requests.
Priya: I'll write a concise benchmark blurb (2 lines) and append a methodology link. Avoid naming customers.
Ava: Neutral phrasing only. Appendix must include dataset, workloads, and device mix.
Marco: Webinar ask  can we run a 30-min "Pricing & Performance" session next Wed aimed at teams that cross 100k tokens/month? Use the estimator as the hook.
Taylor: I'll do live QA and a quick demo of the quiz -> routing -> AE handoff. Add a 5-min lightning demo.
Jon: I'll create a registration landing page in Marketo and tag registrants with inbound label "estimator_trial". Marco, what's the follow-up cadence?
Marco: 24h follow-up email + AE outreach for est_tokens_month > 200k; otherwise automated nurture.
Ava: UX feedback: testers said too many steps. We trimmed to 3 Qs and added progress microcopy in variant B.
Priya: FAQ update: added "How accurate is the estimate?" -> "Estimates use your inputs and typical workload patterns; contact sales for contract sizing."
Jon: Add an inline CTA in the FAQ: `Have a nonstandard workload? Book 15 mins` -> scheduler link. That improves conversion.
Taylor: Inbound tag plan: include estimator_variant:microquiz and tier_suggestion in lead metadata.
Ava: Monitoring for next 72h: estimator conversion (click->contact), demo signups, drop on Q1, FAQ CTR. Dashboards incoming.
Priya: Benchmark blurb draft posted to the appendix doc: https://redwood.design/appendix/estimator-bench (will swap to canonical link).
Marco: Suggest adding an ROI example line but keep anonymized: "Example: a 200M token workload saw ~60% cost reduction from caching and batching."
Ava: Use percentages not raw $ numbers to avoid leakage.
Jon: Track events: estimator_submitted, quiz_flow_version, recommended_tier, treatment_flag. Need these in analytics schema.
Ava: Logged and tagged analytics.
Priya: Also propose a micro A/B on tier labels: 50% see "Launch / Growth / Enterprise" vs 50% see numeric bands "<50k / 50k-250k / 250k+" to measure clarity. Add feature-flag pricing_tier_label_test.
Taylor: Noted. Support flagged one issue: "Estimator suggested wrong tier for embedding-heavy workloads." We should add a conditional follow-up when use case = embeddings.
Ava: I'll add a conditional question for embeddings.
Jon: Sample lead JSON (to standardize keys): ```{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "est_tokens_month": 220000,
  "recommended_tier": "Growth",
  "tier_rationale": "high concurrency, short chat sessions",
  "estimator_variant": "microquiz_v1"
}```
Taylor: I'll QA the webhook tonight and confirm parsing with Sales.
Marco: I'll update the AE playbook with example rationale strings and follow-up scripts by tomorrow morning.
Ava: Thanks all  I'll share the first 24h snapshot tomorrow AM. :eyes:
